note: The Nine Hells: its planets, moons and asteroid belts, which the scene builder (CarrierBuilder.NineHells) places, laid out as Data/star_system.json is (angles in degrees; distances and heights from the star in the layout's km, times StarSystemData.LayoutScale for the level and CarrierBuilder.DistanceScale for the real orbit; radii and arrival distances real, in metres; moons' distances from their planets real, in km; mass a fraction of what the body goes round; spin in degrees a second). airless: no air at all (a planet has air unless it is). K'rzyn's year sets the star's mass. Rebuild the scenes (Tools > Carrier > Build All) after changing anything here.

planets.name: The Forge
planets.description: The innermost world, baked and airless: grey rock pocked with craters, with the star huge in its black sky. Nothing lives here.

planets.name: Paradise
planets.description: A hot water world under unbroken cloud, the old picture of Venus: steaming oceans round high, steep mountains, and rain that never stops.

planets.name: K'rzyn
planets.description: Home: an Earth-like world well inside the habitable zone, with two moons. Its capital, Heaven, lies under an energy shield that stops bombardment from orbit.

planets.name: Rephaim
planets.description: A gas giant of unknown depths, its bands torn by storms that have raged for centuries. A refuelling station and a mineral refiner work in its orbit; it has four moons.

planets.name: Judecca
planets.description: An icy world with air: continents of ice between methane seas. Human pirates hold it, with two fortified cities, ships on its seas and submarines under them. Three moons.

planets.name: Goliath
planets.description: A giant rocky world with a thin atmosphere, dead, but for the ruins of a race long gone. A small allied research facility on the surface takes ships in for repairs.

planets.name: Gilgal
planets.description: A great ringed giant of hydrogen and helium with no surface at all, and seven moons. Pirates hold two of them, and a pirate picket fleet patrols the rings.

planets.name: Nineveh
planets.description: An airless world of ice, far from the star. An allied observatory and research station here watches what moves outside the Nine Hells.

planets.name: Sheol
planets.description: The last and darkest world, small and icy, hardly bigger than a moon. A Vrask outpost holds it, ringed by defence satellites and a picket fleet.

moons.name: Seraph
moons.description: K'rzyn's larger moon: grey, cratered and airless, bright in its night sky.

moons.name: Cherub
moons.description: K'rzyn's small outer moon, a lumpy grey rock.

moons.name: Anak
moons.description: The largest of Rephaim's moons, its old craters filled with dark dust from the storms below.

moons.name: Og
moons.description: A dark moon of Rephaim, cracked by the giant's pull.

moons.name: Emim
moons.description: One of Rephaim's moons, grey and cratered.

moons.name: Zuzim
moons.description: Rephaim's outermost moon, small and dark.

moons.name: Caina
moons.description: A moon of Judecca, its surface ice over rock.

moons.name: Antenora
moons.description: A moon of Judecca, grey and cratered.

moons.name: Ptolomea
moons.description: Judecca's smallest moon, a dark rock far out.

moons.name: Ai
moons.description: A small moon of Gilgal just outside its rings.

moons.name: Jericho
moons.description: A large moon of Gilgal, held by the pirates: their main base is here.

moons.name: Bethel
moons.description: A moon of Gilgal, held by the pirates: their second base is here.

moons.name: Mizpah
moons.description: A small moon of Gilgal, cratered and dark.

moons.name: Gibeon
moons.description: One of Gilgal's larger moons, far out.

moons.name: Ramah
moons.description: Gilgal's outermost moon, a captured rock.

fields.name: Inner Belt
fields.description: The inner asteroid belt, between K'rzyn and Rephaim: rocks of iron, nickel, silicates and here and there platinum, to mine.

fields.name: Outer Belt
fields.description: The outer asteroid belt, between Gilgal and Nineveh: darker rocks, rich in ices, carbon and rare metals, to mine.
